run_fuse_gtest: run fuse_gtest_files.py to merge Google Test source into a single header and source file
run_fuse_gtest_with_root: run fuse_gtest_files.py with a custom GTEST_ROOT_DIR and output directory to fuse gtest files
fuse_gtest_h: fuse all Google Test header files into a single gtest.h output file
fuse_gtest_all_cc: fuse all Google Test source files into a single gtest-all.cc output file
validate_gtest_root: validate that a given directory is a valid Google Test root directory
